name: scenario_0348
description: The user is studying for upcoming exams and has a syllabus note outlining the topics they need to cover. They have gathered several reference materials (images of textbook pages and slides) and want to cross-reference their syllabus with these materials to track their progress and extract key examples.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Here are pictures of my study materials. Please check my 'Exam Syllabus' note, cross-reference the topics listed there with the concepts shown in these images, and update the note by appending ' - FOUND' to the topics that are actually covered in these materials.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to look at the provided images of study materials, find your 'Exam Syllabus' note, and update it by adding ' - FOUND' next to any topic that appears in the images. Because you have multiple notes with the same title from different classes, the assistant should ask you to clarify which one you mean. When it does, tell it you mean the one containing computer science and math topics like Hash Tables and Discrete Logarithms. Do not list the topics from the images yourself; let the assistant identify them from the visual content. Once the assistant confirms the note has been updated, move to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Great. Now I need to find materials for the topics from the syllabus that were NOT covered in these images. Please create a Todoist task to 'Find study materials for [Topic]' for each of those missing topics.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the topics from the syllabus note that were NOT marked as found in the previous step. For each of these missing topics, instruct the assistant to create a Todoist task titled 'Find study materials for [Topic]'. Do not name the missing topics yourself; the assistant must deduce them from the remaining unmarked items in the note. Once the assistant confirms the tasks are created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3
Query: Let's start compiling notes for the topics we did find. Create a new note called 'Cheat Sheet' and extract these specific examples from the images: the values of the leaves from the tree data structure diagram, the numbers in the first row of the 4x4 lower triangular matrix, and the discrete logarithm (index) of 7 modulo 13.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to create a new note titled 'Cheat Sheet'. Tell the assistant to look back at the images and extract three specific pieces of information to put in this note: the values of the leaves in the tree diagram, the numbers in the very first row of the 4x4 lower triangular matrix, and the discrete logarithm (also called the index) of 7 modulo 13. Do not provide the actual numbers or values yourself; the assistant must read them from the images. If the assistant asks for clarification or extracts the wrong values (like grabbing the upper triangular matrix instead), point it back to the specific diagram or table in the images. Once the note is created with the correct extracted details, end the conversation.
